text:
marta (Sales): FYI inbound SIG from EdgeCore, they marked it high-priority  deadline EOD Friday. They also added a KMS requirement for customer-managed keys

josh (SE): Can you drop the questionnaire here? I want to check if its standard CAIQ or custom controls.

marta (Sales): pasted PDF link: https://edgecore.example.com/sig/edgecore-sig-2026.pdf  main asks: HSM-backed keys, in-region dedicated instances, and longer retention for logs.

lina (Security): thanks. Quick read: looks like CAIQ v4 + 8 custom questions about key ownership and attestations. The HSM ask is the blocker.

josh (SE): To be concrete: they want customer-managed KEK in HSM during inference, not just at rest. That9s a Dedicated/Private-only requirement. We need to confirm Dedicated capacity + KMS integration path.

marta (Sales): EdgeCore says: "POC must use our keys for compliance  cannot use provider-managed keys" and they need contract language + an architecture diagram before legal signs off.

lina (Security): @marta can you add whether they require FIPS 140-2 level 3 or just HSM-backed? That changes options.

alex-customer: they clarified in the form: FIPS 140-2 L3 attestation + auditable key wrap ops. POC can run in our AWS account (gov region).

josh (SE): Good  if customer will host in their VPC we can propose Private deployment (air-gapped or VPC) with KMS/HSM integration. Need engineering ETA on a scoped POC setup and cost estimate.

lina (Security): I can sign off on architecture once we have diagram + KMS workflow. Also need to confirm audit log retention policy: they want 7 years. That's more than standard  legal will push back on storage cost.

marta (Sales): action list: 1) @josh prepare POC architecture diagram & rough cost for Dedicated vs Private 2) @lina list compliance gating items (FIPS attestation, key wrapping proof, log retention) 3) I9ll send them contract addendum draft. Need updates by tomorrow noon.

ps_bot: Deployment checklist created: #ticket-8762. Assigned to josh, lina. SLA: 48h.

josh (SE): Starting diagram now. Question: do we need to demo live HSM unwrap during POC or will a signed attestation suffice?

lina (Security): For POC, an attestation + demonstrable key wrap process is OK, but production will require live HSM integration. Marking production-only constraint in the questionnaire reply.

marta (Sales): Customer replied: "POC must include a demo of key wrap/unwarp using our HSM gateway." They want it recorded.

josh (SE): Ok  that ups effort. I9ll estimate 2 engineer-days to wire up the HSM gateway in a Private VPC POC, plus 1 day for recording and runbook.

lina (Security): Also: they asked about data plane residency. Confirming: inference can run in their account/region?

alex-customer: yes  we will provide an AWS account in us-gov-west-1 and temporary admin role for the POC.

josh (SE): Good. I9ll include an IAM scope and minimal trust policy snippet. Example:
```
- Role: redwood-poc-setup
- Permissions: ec2:*, kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, logs:CreateLogGroup
- Note: we9ll narrow to least privilege after trial
```

lina (Security): For the questionnaire reply, we should answer the CAIQ controls that map to key management + logging. I9ll draft responses and call out the HSM as "Private-only / requires customer infra".

marta (Sales): Risk scoring: customer gave us a compliance scorecard; they put us as "high-risk" until we provide KMS demo and contract clause. We need to push timeline to meet their procurement window.

josh (SE): Cost-wise: Private POC estimate = $6k for 5 days (incl. SRE hours + infra). Dedicated scoped POC higher due to reserved capacity. I9ll add line items in the estimate.

lina (Security): I9ll add a required deliverable: signed HSM attestation document from their side and one from our ops team after the demo.

marta (Sales): I9ll message procurement and legal. Also asking if we can offer an interim mitigation (shorter log retention + exportable logs) to unblock procurement while we schedule the HSM demo.

alex-customer: Procurement would accept exportable logs for POC but must see the HSM demo before GA.

josh (SE): Summary for the thread: - POC mode: Private in customer's AWS account - HSM: demo required (POC) + production-live integration later - Cost estimate & diagram due tomorrow noon - Security to draft CAIQ answers marking HSM as Private-only

lina (Security): I9ll upload draft CAIQ reply to the ticket and flag the three gating items.

marta (Sales): Thanks team. If we hit the noon target I9ll push to procurement to keep them in the pipeline. Marking this thread HIGH PRIORITY. :rotating_light:
